items.description: Copper pipe repair – fittings, pipe section and consumables
items.rationale: Fracture of a heating pipe inside the building is insured (2.4.3(a)); like-for-like materials and consumables are repair costs under 7.1.7(c). Priced for about 1 m of copper pipe plus fittings at an ordinary market rate.

Trade labour at customary rates is covered under 7.1.7(g). About 12 technician hours plus part-time helper would be roughly 1,300 gross, trimmed to about 1,050 because a 1 m pipe repair hardly needs a day and a half.

Insulation that was in place before the loss is covered under 7.1.7(c). But 6 pieces for a 1 m repaired section exceeds the documented repair (7.1.8(e)), so only the quantity for the repaired section is likely accepted.
One travel or call-out charge per contractor per invoice is covered under 7.1.7(f), and this is the only one. Priced at the level of the reference case (at least 60).
Disposal of the removed pipe and old insulation is covered under 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1. The volume is a single small bag, so a modest price applies.
General administrative or processing charges are contractor's own business outlay and excluded under 7.1.8(b).

items.description: Tile cleaning, disinfection and coating, 5 hrs
items.rationale: The tiles were not physically damaged (7.1.5). Cleaning and disinfection are cleanliness/upkeep and the coating is an improvement not present before (7.1.8(a), 7.1.9); the combined line mixes these, so it is most likely not indemnified.
